situations.title: MH 가족력 선별
situations.tagline: Has anyone in your family ever had a serious reaction to general anesthesia?
situations.brief: 마취 전 악성 고열 가족력을 선별하세요.
keyPhrases: Has any family member reacted badly to anesthesia?
This helps us screen for malignant hyperthermia risk.
Any high fevers or muscle problems under anesthesia?

situations.title: 유발 약물 인지
situations.tagline: For this patient we avoid the volatile agents and succinylcholine — they can trigger MH.
situations.brief: 악성 고열 유발 약물을 인지하고 회피하세요.
keyPhrases: Volatile agents and succinylcholine are MH triggers.
We'll use a trigger-free technique for this case.
Let's confirm the triggers are off the machine.

situations.title: dantrolene 위치 확인
situations.tagline: Before induction, let's confirm where the dantrolene is and that we have enough vials.
situations.brief: 단트롤렌 위치와 재고를 확인하세요.
keyPhrases: Where is the dantrolene stored for this room?
Let's confirm we have enough vials on hand.
I want it accessible before we induce.

situations.title: MH 카트 점검
situations.tagline: Let's run through the MH cart — dantrolene, sterile water, cold saline, and the algorithm card.
situations.brief: 악성 고열 대응 카트를 점검하세요.
keyPhrases: Let's inventory the MH cart together.
Dantrolene, sterile water, cold saline, and the protocol card.
Everything's stocked and in date.

situations.title: 체온 지속 감시
situations.tagline: Core temp probe is in — we'll trend the temperature continuously throughout the case.
situations.brief: 수술 내내 중심 체온을 지속 감시하세요.
keyPhrases: The core temperature probe is in place.
We'll trend the temp continuously.
Any sudden rise, we call it out immediately.

situations.title: EtCO2 감시
situations.tagline: Keep an eye on the EtCO2 — an unexplained rise can be the earliest sign of MH.
situations.brief: EtCO2를 감시하여 조기 징후를 포착하세요.
keyPhrases: Watch the EtCO2 trend closely.
An unexplained rise can be the first MH sign.
I'll flag any climb right away.

situations.title: EtCO2 상승 조기 인지
situations.tagline: The EtCO2 keeps climbing despite ventilation — I'm concerned this could be early MH.
situations.brief: 원인 불명의 EtCO2 상승을 조기 인지하세요.
keyPhrases: EtCO2 is rising despite adequate ventilation.
This pattern makes me think early MH.
Let's alert anesthesia and get ready.
goals: 원인 불명 EtCO2 상승을 조기 인지한다

situations.title: masseter 근강직 관찰
situations.tagline: There's masseter rigidity after induction — jaw's really tight, this could be an MH warning.
situations.brief: 교근 강직을 관찰하고 악성 고열을 의심하세요.
keyPhrases: There's masseter rigidity after induction.
A tight jaw can be an early MH sign.
Let's watch for other signs and prep the cart.

situations.title: 빈맥·부정맥 감시
situations.tagline: Heart rate's climbing with some ectopy — let's watch the rhythm alongside the EtCO2 and temp.
situations.brief: 빈맥과 부정맥을 감시하며 악성 고열을 살피세요.
keyPhrases: The heart rate is climbing with ectopy.
Let's correlate the rhythm with EtCO2 and temp.
I'll call out any run of arrhythmia.
goals: 다른 MH 징후와 연관 지어 사정한다

situations.title: 대사성 산증 확인
situations.tagline: The gas shows a mixed acidosis — combined with the rising temp, this fits an MH picture.
situations.brief: 대사성 산증을 확인하고 악성 고열 소견에 반영하세요.
keyPhrases: The blood gas shows a mixed acidosis.
With the rising temperature this fits MH.
Let's factor this into the crisis assessment.

situations.title: MH 감수성 환자 준비
situations.tagline: You have a known MH history, so we're taking special precautions to keep you safe today.
situations.brief: 악성 고열 감수성 환자를 위한 준비를 설명하세요.
keyPhrases: Because of your MH history we avoid triggering agents.
We have a special plan and medications ready for you.
You're in safe hands — we've prepared for this.

situations.title: 유발약 회피 마취
situations.tagline: We'll run a trigger-free technique — machine flushed, vaporizers removed, TIVA ready.
situations.brief: 유발약을 배제한 마취를 준비하세요.
keyPhrases: We're doing a trigger-free anesthetic.
The machine is flushed and the vaporizers are off.
TIVA is drawn up and ready.

situations.title: 냉각 물품 준비
situations.tagline: Let's stage the cold saline and cooling supplies now, in case we need to cool fast.
situations.brief: 급속 냉각에 대비해 냉각 물품을 준비하세요.
keyPhrases: Let's stage cold saline and ice packs.
Have the cooling blanket ready.
If we need to cool fast, everything's within reach.

situations.title: 고칼륨 감시
situations.tagline: Let's send a potassium — MH can drive it up fast and threaten the rhythm.
situations.brief: 악성 고열 진행 시 고칼륨혈증을 감시하세요.
keyPhrases: Let's send a potassium level now.
Hyperkalemia can rise fast in MH.
Watch the rhythm for peaked T waves.

situations.title: 미오글로빈뇨 관찰
situations.tagline: The Foley output is turning dark — myoglobinuria would fit muscle breakdown from MH.
situations.brief: 소변 색 변화로 미오글로빈뇨를 관찰하세요.
keyPhrases: The urine is turning dark, cola-colored.
That suggests myoglobinuria from muscle breakdown.
Let's note the output and send labs.

situations.title: MH 위기 발동
situations.tagline: This is malignant hyperthermia — I'm calling it, get the MH cart and call for help now!
situations.brief: 악성 고열 위기를 선언하고 팀을 소집하세요.
keyPhrases: This is malignant hyperthermia — I'm declaring it.
Get the MH cart and call for help now.
Stop all triggering agents immediately.

situations.title: dantrolene 혼합 투여
situations.tagline: Grab everyone to reconstitute dantrolene — we need many vials mixed fast, start dosing now.
situations.brief: 단트롤렌을 신속히 혼합하여 투여하세요.
keyPhrases: All hands reconstituting dantrolene now.
We dose by weight and repeat as needed.
Keep mixing — we'll need a lot of vials.

situations.title: 급속 냉각 시행
situations.tagline: Start active cooling — cold saline in, ice to the groin and axillae, cooling blanket on.
situations.brief: 급속 냉각을 즉시 시행하세요.
keyPhrases: Start cold IV saline and surface cooling.
Ice packs to the groin and axillae.
Stop cooling before we overshoot.

situations.title: 고칼륨 부정맥 대응
situations.tagline: Potassium is dangerously high and the rhythm's changing — let's treat the hyperkalemia now.
situations.brief: 고칼륨성 부정맥을 즉시 처치하세요.
keyPhrases: Potassium is critically high.
Calcium, insulin with glucose, and bicarb per protocol.
Watch the monitor for rhythm changes.

situations.title: 대사성 산증 교정
situations.tagline: The acidosis is severe — hyperventilate and give bicarb per the gas, and keep resampling.
situations.brief: 대사성 산증을 교정하며 지표를 재확인하세요.
keyPhrases: The acidosis is severe on the gas.
Hyperventilate and give bicarbonate per protocol.
Let's resample the gas after treatment.

situations.title: 위기 후 중환자 이송
situations.tagline: He's stabilizing on dantrolene — let's set up the ICU handoff for continued monitoring.
situations.brief: 악성 고열 위기 후 중환자실 이송을 준비하세요.
keyPhrases: He's stabilizing but needs ICU-level monitoring.
Let's give ICU a full MH handoff.
Continue dantrolene and watch for recrudescence.
